scope: Photo acquisition/display rights and useful online buyer information; research only
method: Targeted primary-source web research, local source/code review, and two tool-disabled Claude CLI review rounds. No exhaustive image coverage survey.

findings: Street View screenshots and extraction from embedded imagery are expressly prohibited by the published guidelines.
General supported embedding/API display exists; this is different from acquiring reusable image files.
Street View restrictions also cover deriving data and application-based analysis/extraction. Ordinary Google Maps map-screenshot guidance is not permission for Street View screenshots.
General linking to Google Maps is permitted. Fair-use applicability is case-specific, not decided by Google guidance.
source_notes.decision: Do not build a screenshot or Street View OCR collection pipeline. External links are an available option.

findings: Core-services terms restrict extraction, storage, caching and creation of derived content, subject to stated exceptions.
The directory/listing provision and restrictions involving non-Google maps are directly relevant to this directory's MapLibre/OSM implementation.
source_notes.decision: API availability is not approval for this exact commercial directory. Resolve applicable product/contract terms before an integration. This is not a judicial determination that every possible use is illegal.

findings: Places API permits display without a corresponding map but restricts use with non-Google maps.
Places UI Kit has an explicit exception for non-Google maps. This is not a general photo-storage or directory-use exception.
ID caching exceptions do not authorize an owned image archive.
source_notes.scope: Non-EEA terms page; a particular customer's actual agreement and billing jurisdiction must be checked before implementation.

findings: Maps Embed API currently has no usage charge and requires an API key; license restrictions still apply.
source_notes.decision: Price is separate from permitted purpose; do not generalize the free tier to other APIs.

findings: Panorama IDs have a caching exception; attribution and applicable product policies remain required.
source_notes.decision: No general right to save and rehost image files.

findings: Photos have author-attribution and source-photo access requirements, with documented layout-specific details.
source_notes.decision: Do not treat Google Maps UI photos as downloadable merchant-owned assets.

findings: Photos are protected when created; possessing a photo or being its subject is different from owning its copyright.
source_notes.decision: For merchant-supplied photos, obtain a license from someone who actually holds the rights. Public availability or attribution alone does not supply permission.

findings: Help page describes contributed imagery under CC BY-SA with source, contributor and license attribution.
unknowns: API acquisition and current full terms
source_notes.terms_access_result: JavaScript shell only; full terms not readable with the web text tool
source_notes.decision: Conditional research candidate, not an approved ready-to-deploy feed.

findings: Reuse depends on the individual file's creator/license and attribution/derivative conditions.
source_notes.decision: Verify each file; do not transfer a platform-wide permission assumption to every image.

source_notes.creator: David Hilowitz
findings: A named, dated, openly licensed district-image candidate exists.
source_notes.decision: Possible historical district-context illustration after visual suitability review; not evidence of a merchant's current facade or operation.
source_notes.coverage_limit: One file examined from a category containing 4 files. No exhaustive Commons search or coverage estimate.

findings: Commercial-plate freight loading and ordinary-car passenger/baggage loading have different yellow-zone conditions. Posted signs and other regulations apply.
source_notes.decision: Useful general loading explainer; does not identify a specific merchant's loading space or authorize parking there.

findings: Meter rates vary by area and sometimes time; metered spaces cannot be reserved.
source_notes.decision: Replace unsupported district-wide price promises with dated official guidance and the relevant live source.

findings: A seller's permit copy is not a substitute for a resale certificate.
source_notes.decision: Separate tax documentation, merchant account approval and pricing eligibility. Link to official guidance; do not collect buyers' documents or provide individualized tax conclusions.

source_notes.new_vs_previous_pilot: new policy information, not in the existing 11 online facts
findings: Policy states general sales are final and returns/refunds/exchanges are not accepted.
Incorrect delivered items should be reported within the merchant's stated 48 business hours for replacement and a return label.
Air-filled balloons sold at the physical location and helium items have specific nonrefund language.
source_notes.scope: Merchant-published policy, not a statement of legal enforceability or all statutory rights. Preserve business-hours wording; do not convert it into two calendar days.

findings: Page still displayed a shipping-pause notice for the week of 2026-03-16 with resumption on 2026-03-23.
source_notes.decision: Do not interpret this October page retrieval as evidence of a current shipping pause; checked_at is not source freshness.

findings: A 30-day-return/worldwide-shipping block appears next to Lorem ipsum and generic account-return instructions.
source_notes.decision: Possible template residue; not proof the policy is false, but insufficient to publish a universal merchant promise without confirmation.

findings: Official navigation includes Funko Pops, LEGO and Bandai collections.
source_notes.decision: Can support attributed catalog-category links, not current in-store stock, wholesale availability or authorized-dealer certification.

findings: Public page differentiates US retail free shipping from wholesale pricing that requires login.
source_notes.decision: Public retail prices cannot be used as wholesale quotes or to calculate reseller profit.

findings: CPSC provides public recall information through XML/JSON web services for consumers, businesses and developers.
source_notes.decision: Useful official lookup/link candidate. Automated matching would require exact product identification and freshness validation; no search result is not safety or compliance certification.
limits: API documentation landing page examined; API integration and product matching not performed
No local merchant product checked against recalls
Not part of the two completed Claude review rounds

findings: Official resource hub includes reseller guidance, product certificate information and product-safety resources.
source_notes.decision: Link as a buyer preparation resource; do not label a product compliant or a merchant unsafe from generic guidance.

findings: OpenStreetMap data reuse is subject to its license and attribution requirements.
source_notes.decision: Any later itinerary calculation needs appropriately sourced coordinates and a usable pedestrian network. Straight-line distance is not a verified walking route, travel time, accessibility or safety score.
